Request: Create directory /srv/www
Initial states: baseline: /srv/www absent; adversarial: directory exists with a file keep.

  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Create directory /srv/www
    file:
      path: /srv/www
      state: directory
      owner: www-data
      group: www-data
      mode: 0755
